about: Kept by hand. Adds what data/issuers.json lacks: names a company filed under before a rename that neither IDX's current list nor the Wikipedia snapshot carries (aliases), and any issuer missing from both. Every entry says where the name was read. AADI and EMAS are on IDX's list since 2026-11-01 and kept here only as a record.

issuers.name: Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk
issuers.source: printed on the statements in ~/FinancialReport/AADI (7 filings, Q4 2024 onward); listed after the Wikipedia snapshot

issuers.name: Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk
issuers.source: printed on the statements in ~/FinancialReport/EMAS; listed after the Wikipedia snapshot

issuers.name: Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk
issuers.source: 13 filings in ~/FinancialReport/ADMR print the former name, 5 the current one

issuers.name: PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk
aliases: Perusahaan Perkebunan London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk
issuers.source: the legal name printed on every statement in ~/FinancialReport/LSIP; IDX abbreviates it to "PP"

issuers.name: ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk
issuers.source: 8 ESSA filings in ~/Downloads/idx (Q1 2022 to Q4 2023) print the former name PT Surya Esa Perkasa Tbk; the files are named ESSA
